title: The resolver would have bound a DIFFERENT value than the operator gave — the ask was necessary

provenance.source_test: authored for the replay: the discriminating case a proxy cannot see

asks.label: necessary
asks.why: This is the case that separates a replay from an aggregator. The binder DID hold a candidate (the profile spine default), so any 'did it try?' proxy scores this ask as resolved-and-therefore-avoidable. But the candidate was WRONG: the operator redirected the output elsewhere. Asking was correct, and a silent bind would have written to the stale directory. Only re-running the resolver and comparing against the answer can tell this apart from ra10-profile-spine-output-dir, whose situation is structurally identical.
